vr16-loose-opposite.description: Chose a loosely different word, not a true opposite.
vr16-loose-opposite.childHint: A true opposite flips the meaning exactly, like hot and cold.

vr16-synonym-pull.description: Chose a word meaning the same instead of the opposite.
vr16-synonym-pull.childHint: You found a twin. Now find the reverse.

vr16-loose-opposite.execution: The card says hot and asks for its opposite, which is cold. This option is warm: warm is hot turned down, not hot turned round; the opposite is cold. It is a different word, but not the one that flips the meaning.

The card says buy and asks for its OPPOSITE, which is sell. This option is give. Giving hands a thing over, the other way from buying. But no money comes back, so it is not the reverse; the opposite is sell.

The card says remember and asks for its OPPOSITE, which is forget. This option is misplace. To misplace a thing is to lose it, often after forgetting where it went. It points away from remember, but it does not flip the meaning; the opposite is forget.
